entries.policy: Validated SceneIR, identities, camera, geometry, lights and declared resources are frozen into one ProductSnapshot.
A valid graph is deterministically realized and revalidated; an invalid required graph rejects before GPU allocation.
The runtime never executes ambient scripts; required script execution rejects and optional build provenance remains tooling metadata.
Content identity, dependency, domain, residency and all resource budgets are resolved; missing, conflicting or unsafe bindings reject.
The supported solver subset compiles into product constraints; unavailable required modes reject and optional unavailable modes remain explicit.
A bounded time plan is compiled; required dynamic domains reject until PRV.7 and optional domains remain tooling-visible.
Validate, inspect, build, migrate, pack, unpack and realize execute through one versioned runtime extension with Direct, Worker and CLI parity.
Adapter provenance and declared loss remain inspectable; required unowned adapter semantics reject and adapters do not create a second renderer.
Rebuildable caches remain optional and excluded from package semantic identity; external dependencies reject self-contained execution.
Retained positive and negative fixtures execute through the maintained Release gate and scene-tool diagnostic matrix.
